name: Lab Notebook
summary: Pale graph paper, deep ink, one teal accent, system fonts. A reference whose numbers say what kind of number they are: exact, measured or rounded, as a rule style and a word. The table is the page.

for: pages with constants, measurements or counts
tools that compute something (a balancer, a converter)

type.display: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
type.text: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
type.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

shape.note: numbers and formulas in mono; solid hex tints only (no color-mix, which contrast probes misread); graph-paper grid behind the hero only, faded out

signature.name: the table as the picture
signature.rule: The home hero is the data's own structure drawn as squares: one square per item in its true position, pattern (solid, hatched, outlined, dotted) for kind, a dashed edge for what is only partly measured. The caption prints the counts, and they are computed from the same data file as the page's table.
signature.carries: how many things exist, how they are arranged, and which kinds are only predicted
signature.derived_from: data/elements.json: 118 squares, counts per class computed at build time

motifs.use: every figure in a table or list of numbers
motifs.rule: A left rule and a word: solid Exact (by definition or convention), dashed Measured, dotted Rounded. The marks describe the kind of number, not a ranking of trust; say so, and say which figures carry a mark and which do not.

motifs.use: a grid of selectable items on a phone
motifs.rule: A compact card pinned to the bottom of the viewport, at most 15% of its height, with a close button; never a card above the grid that scrolls away from the thumb.
Refuse impossible or ambiguous input in plain words, say what was ignored (typed coefficients, state symbols), and recount the answer from its printed form.

never: a claim that every number is marked when only listed figures are
a count presented as exact by definition
a mark that reads as a trust ranking
color-mix() or other computed colours for text backgrounds that a probe must verify
a checkbox or control under 44px (use a toggle chip)
a table that scrolls sideways without a visible cue and a nearby detail view

provenance.source_run: SolutionsAsService/ScienceEncyclopedia, Adaptive Full run bounded to one panel round (Krug, Debord, Cairo); see its DESIGN-LOG.md
measured: Mobile Floor 12 of 12 at 360, 390 and 430px on all pages tested, re-run after each change set
0 horizontal overflow across 116 loads, 0 broken links of 728, 0 external requests (Cairo)
balancer: 38 of 38 successful answers recounted independently; 14 known answers and 18 bad inputs in scripts/check-balancer.js
category tints: ink on every tint 7:1 or better in both modes (validator)
open: one panel round; S1 and S2 not met
text and values from general knowledge, not checked against IUPAC, CODATA or NIST
not shown on a real phone
the Rounded mark mixes fewer-digits and typical-value
